# Draft:Global Foundation for the Neglect of Digital Culture

The Global Foundation for the Neglect of Digital Culture (GFNDC) is an independent, nonprofit institute dedicated to the preservation and analysis of neglected digital media.
Founded in 2007 in San Francisco, GFNDC operates globally within multiple jurisdictions, focusing on the recovery of early internet artifacts and the documentation of emergent digital phenomena.
The organization maintains a decentralized infrastructure across five countries and emphasizes ethical, context-aware digital archiving practices.
